news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.85 (vs ₹0.80 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.85 (up from ₹0.80 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹1.91b (up 31% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹161.9m (up 23% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 8.5% (down from 9.0% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 13% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 2% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.
